name: Mom's biryani, just talking
input: okay so first you take the chicken about a kilo and put the yogurt maybe a cup. then the masala you know the red chilli, haldi, a little salt and leave it for 30 minutes. after that boil three cups of rice with four cardamom for 7 minutes and drain it. then you cook the chicken until the oil comes up. then layer the rice and keep it on low heat for 20 minutes

name: Ingredient list then steps
input: you'll need two cups of flour, a cup of milk, two eggs and a pinch of salt. whisk everything together and then rest the batter for 10 minutes. then fry in a hot pan for a couple of minutes each side
